definitions.gloss: to catch up with, to overtake
definitions.explanation: To reach the same level or position as someone ahead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{追|お}い{付|つ}かない。
examples.english: I can't keep up with work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{付|つ}こうとした。
examples.english: I tried to catch up to the front.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{付|つ}いた。
examples.english: Japan's technology caught up with the rest of the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧{追|お}い{付|つ}こうとした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{行|い}ってしまった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I tried to run and catch up, but the bus had already left.

notes:
{追|お}い{付|つ}く means to catch up with someone or something ahead, either physically or figuratively.

TRANSITIVITY:
Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{付|つ}く: to catch up with ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{付|つ}く: to catch up with him
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{付|つ}かない: can't keep up with work
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{付|つ}く: to keep up with the times

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧: to chase, pursue
- ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}す→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧: to overtake, pass (go beyond)
- ⟦{追|お}い{掛|か}ける→追い掛ける：04628_oikakeru⟧: to chase after, run after

ASPECT (ている):
- {追|お}い{付|つ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: has caught up (resultative state)
- Note: {追|お}い{付|つ}く is a punctual achievement verb — the action is instantaneous. The て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form expresses the resulting state of being level with the target, not an ongoing process of catching up. For "is (still) trying to catch up," use {追|お}い{付|つ}こう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ or the progressive ⟦{追|お}い{掛|か}けて→追い掛ける：04628_oikakeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧.
